BiblicalUsage: Chabatstseleth is a flower of the meadow — a crocus, or a rose. The beloved says she is the rose of Sharon, and Isaiah promises the desert will blossom as the rose.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God plants His roses in the desert on purpose, so no one can say beauty belongs only to gardens.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
